Mara: Quick sync — draft for SI onboarding orientation. Thinking 3-day sequence: day1 product + marketplace, day2 hands-on labs (sandbox), day3 cert exam + joint GTM prep. Thoughts?
Priya: I like 3-day. Suggest prework: 2 short videos + quiz so labs start at same baseline.
Matt: For labs, we need sandbox with 1 model pinned, sample prompts, and observability play. Can provisioning scripts be ready?
Ravi: We can spin up tenant sandboxes. Need list of GPU/instance types + expected qps. Also, KMS keys? For demos, we'll use ephemeral keys.
Jordan: DevEx can build lab guide + Terraform repo. Recommend pages: Quickstart, Common Gotchas, Eval checklist.
Kelly: Sales wants joint announcement collateral. Add a co-branded slide deck + 2 customer use cases. Timeline?
Mara: Target public beta with 2 SIs in 6 weeks. Announcement synced with marketplace listing. @kelly can you own partner comms?
Kelly: Yep. I'll draft a PRD for assets and share by EOD Wed.
Priya: Certification tiers: Bronze (orientation), Silver (labs pass), Gold (capstone project + customer-ready). Need grading rubric.
Matt: Capstone should include latency/cost optimization task. We'll evaluate with a short postmortem.
Jordan: I'll create lab infra repo and a CI pipeline to auto-validate lab submissions. Will need `si_onboard` service account.
Ravi: send me the list of service accounts + required IAM perms. We'll generate tokens.
Lia-bot: ACTION Created task #4302: 'SI onboarding lab infra — create service accounts' assigned to Ravi. Due 2025-06-05 :calendar:
Mara: Great. Next steps: Priya to draft syllabus, Jordan to scaffold repo, Ravi to provision sandboxes, Kelly to start comms. Weekly check-in Friday 11am. :thumbsup:
